reason: Bone cells seem like the next component needed to make the framework living bone.

reaction: The sliding inset makes the cartilage's role clear.
reason: The synovial capsule is a sleeve containing fluid, so it seems suited to enclosing the elbow joint.
expectation: The capsule will surround the cartilage-covered joint and help it move smoothly.

reaction: The explanation clarified the fluid’s role in movement.
reason: The elbow ligaments are shown spanning its sides, so they should support the enclosed joint.
expectation: The ligaments will connect and support the bones at the elbow.

effect: The ligaments completed the movable arm skeleton, showing how the elbow can bend while resisting sideways movement.
reaction: The distinction between bending and sideways support was clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding mineral to the collagen framework was most worthwhile: the result explained how collagen provides toughness while mineral resists compression.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding bone cells and then blood vessels followed a predictable sequence, though the cutaways helped explain how living cells are supported inside hard bone.

surprise.text: The tiny passages connecting bone cells and carrying nutrients through the hard matrix clarified how bone remains living tissue.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; the item names and picture descriptions gave each combination a recognizable purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, especially to see how the muscle fibre and supported skeleton work together. The biological explanations were clear, although the combinations in this chapter were fairly predictable.
